description: Change of use and works to convert the existing office building (B1) to a mix of uses to include retail/restaurant units (A1- A3) at ground floor level, office space (B1), at first and second floor level,  9 x residential units(3 x 1 bed, 3 x 2 bed & 3 x 3 bed) (C3) at third and fourth floor levels, with associated external alterations including an extension at roof level to create an additional storey, a single storey extension at ground floor level to the front of the building and elevational alterations..
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The A3 use of the ground floor of the premises hereby permitted shall not be carried out outside the following times; 08:00hrs - 24.00hrs.

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies SD6, R1B, R2 and R3 of the London Borough of Camden Replacement Unitary Development Plan 2006.
Condition : 3 - There shall be no outdoor tables or seating at ground floor level outside the following times: 08:00hrs - 22.00hrs.

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies SD6, R1B, R2 and R3 of the London Borough of Camden Replacement Unitary Development Plan 2006.
Condition : 4 - The approved sound insulation measures shall be installed prior to occupation of any of the residential units, and retained and maintained thereafter.

Reason: To safeguard the future residential amenities of the occupiers of the building in accordance with the requirements of polices SD6 and SD7b of the London Borough of Camden Replacement Unitary Development Plan 2006, and advice contained in Planning Policy Guidance 24.
Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the details demonstrated on the drawings hereby approved, detailed drawings in respect of the following shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Council before the relevant part of the work is begun:

A) Plan, elevation and section drawings of all new windows and shopfronts at a scale of 1:50 .

B) Plan, elevation and section drawings of the proposed electricity substation at scale 1:50.

The relevant part of the works shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.

Reason: In order to safeguard the visual amenity of the building, to prevent obstruction to the highway and to ensure noise emanating from the premises does not harm residential amenity in accordance with the requirements of policies SD6, B1, T12 and B3 of the London Borough of Camden Replacement Unitary Development Plan 2006.
Condition : 6 - The details of the facing materials to be used on the building shall not be otherwise than as those submitted to and approved by the Council before any work is commenced on the relevant part of the development. The relevant part of the works shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policy B1 of the London Borough of Camden Replacement Unitary Development Plan 2006.
Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the details demonstrated on the drawings hereby approved, before any A3 use commences at the site, a scheme for the ventilation of and the extraction of fumes from the premises to an adequate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation  for any necessary plant shall be provided and approved in writing by the Council. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and all plant and equipment shall thereafter be maintained in effective order to the reasonable satisfaction of the Council.

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies SD6, R1B, R2 and R3 of the London Borough of Camden Replacement Unitary Development Plan 2006.
Condition : 8 - Noise levels at a point 1 metre external to sensitive facades shall be at least 5dB(A) less than the existing background measurement (LA90), expressed in dB(A) when all plant/equipment are in operation unless the plant/equipment hereby permitted will have a noise that has a distinguishable, discrete continuous note (whine, hiss, screech, hum) and/or if there are distinct impulses (bangs, clicks, clatters, thumps), then the noise levels from that piece of plant/equipment at any sensitive fa�ade shall be at least 10dB(A) below the LA90, expressed in dB(A).

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies SD6 , SD7B, SD8 and Appendix 1 of the London Borough of Camden Replacement Unitary Development Plan 2006.
Condition : 9 - Automatic time clocks shall be fitted to the heat recovery units hereby approved, prior to commencement of the use of the units, to ensure that the plant/equipment does not operate between 20.00hrs and 06:00hrs. The timer equipment shall be properly maintained and retained permanently thereafter.

Reason:- To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policy SD6 of the London Borough of Camden Replacement Unitary Development Plan 2006.
Condition : 10 - No music shall be played on the premises in such a way as to be audible within any adjoining premises or on the adjoining highway. 

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies SD6, R1B, R2 and R3 of the London Borough of Camden Replacement Unitary Development Plan 2006.
Condition : 11 - All of the residential flats shall be completed and available for occupation within 3 months of the first beneficial occupation of any of the A1/A3 floorspace hereby approved.

Reason: To ensure that the development includes the provision of residential units totalling at least 50% of the increase in floorspace  in accordance with policy SD3 of the London Borough of Camden Replacement Unitary Development Plan 2006.
Condition : 12 - The approved cycle storage facilities shall be provided in their entirety in accordance with the details demonstrated on the drawings hereby approved prior to the first occupation of any of the units, and thereafter permanently maintained and retained as such.

Reason: To ensure the development provides adequate cycle parking facilities in accordance with the requirements of policy T3 of the London Borough of Camden Replacement Unitary Development Plan 2006.
Condition : 13 - The approved refuse storage facilities shall be provided in their entirety in strict accordance with the details demonstrated on the drawings hereby approved prior to the first occupation of any of the units, and thereafter permanently maintained and retained as such.

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies SD6, SD7B, SD8, Appendix 1, R1B, R2 and R3 of the London Borough of Camden Replacement Unitary Development Plan 2006.
Condition : 14 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans; 0803 10-101 REV A; 20-201 REV L;  20-202 REV D; 20-203 REV E; 20-204 REV D; 20-205 REV H; 20-206 REV H; 20-251 REV C; 20-253 REV C; 20-255 REV D; 20-271 REV D; 20-272 REV B; 2847-320 REV T1; 10-201 REV A; 10-202 REV A; 10-203 REV A; 10-204 REV A; 10-205 REV A; 10-251 REV A; 10-271 REV A; 10-272 REV A; PPG24 Assessment report by Alan Saunders dated 12th April; Sustainability and energy statement dated 30th March 2010; Plant noise emissions assessment by Alan Saunders dated 12th March 2010; Lifetime Homes Statement; Mechanical Services Performance Specification by Donabie Associates dated 3rd March 2010. Email from Dan Saunders Dated 21/07/2010.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 15 - Prior to the first occupation of the building a plan showing details of the green roof at first floor level at the front of the site including species, planting density, substrate and a section at scale 1:20 showing that adequate depth is available in terms of the construction and long term viability of the green roof, and a programme for an initial scheme of maintenance shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The green roof shall be fully provided in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation and thereafter retained and maintained in accordance with the approved scheme of maintenance.

Reason: To ensure that the green roof is suitably designed and maintained in accordance with the requirements of policies SD9, N5 and B1 of the London Borough of Camden Replacement Unitary Development Plan 2006 and Camden Planning Guidance 2006.
ward: Camden Town with Primrose Hill (Pre May 2022)
